text:
jana.design: Quick sketch: tidy left rail into 4 buckets (Home / Workspaces / Models / Insights). When rail collapses, show compact icons + a single breadcrumb line in header. fig: https://figma.redwood/compact-rail

kevin.pm: Sounds good. Need a URL schema for deep links that supports model+eval+comparison. Suggest: /orgs/:orgId/spaces/:spaceId/sections/:sectionSlug/items/:itemId(+optional: /compare/:otherId). Example: /orgs/redwood/spaces/default/sections/models/items/m-77/compare/m-81

lee.engineer: Agree on path clarity. For ephemeral UI (split panes, inspection mode) use query params: ?view=diff&pane=right. Avoid putting ephemeral state in path so permalinks stay stable.

omri.research: For anchors inside long docs/metrics panels recommend fragments like #latency-p95. Tests show fragments are fastest for scroll-to-section and don't break server routing.

aria.access: A11y checklist: breadcrumb must be a nav with aria-label="Breadcrumb" and the active item needs aria-current="page". Also ensure keyboard order: header -> breadcrumb -> main. If rail toggles, focus should not be trapped in the rail.

jana.design: Copy tweak: rename top-level "Insights" to "Observability"? Kevin — which term is clearer for customers?

kevin.pm: Observability is clearer for enterprise docs, but "Insights" might feel friendlier in product tours. Maybe keep Observability in nav, show "Insights" in marketing banners.

lee.engineer: Routing fallback idea: legacy links like /models/:id should be accepted by server and translate to new path, returning 200 with history.replaceState on client so URL updates without hard reload. That way old links still work and analytics attribute correctly.

omri.research: Edge case: user bookmarks a comparison where one model got deleted. Suggest server returns 200 + banner "Model removed 12 showing available alternative" and set ?fallback=auto on URL. Avoid 404 UX.

aria.access: Also test contrast on breadcrumb separators when header is translucent. Use a separator glyph that meets 4.5:1, maybe middle dot (·) or pipe. Ensure screenreader reads breadcrumb as sequence, not one long link.

jana.design: UX nit: on very small widths show only: Workspace · Section · Item (collapse intermediate segments into a menu). We'll mock interaction.

lee.engineer: We should add route examples to the API docs and add e2e cases: bookmarking, legacy redirect, fragment anchors, query param combos. I'll open a PR with route table.

deploy-bot: deploy started: feat/nav-refactor v2 -> staging by @lee.engineer (sha: b4c3d2)

kevin.pm: tiny follow-up: add keyboard shortcut cheat sheet: G then W -> Workspaces, G then M -> Models. Keep it discoverable from the Help menu. :keyboard:

jana.design: Thanks all. I'll iterate Figma with the compact breadcrumb states + provide the route table and fallback banner copy. Ping me if you want to review the a11y cases.
